context_for_next_testing_agent: The Excalidraw dark theme uses a CSS invert filter on the <canvas>; raw getImageData will return light pixel values even though the visible canvas is dark. rca of the issue: Root cause was already fixed by E1: Excalidraw's dark theme applies filter: invert(93%) hue-rotate(180deg) to the canvas. A forced viewBackgroundColor='#0b0f17' was being inverted to light gray (~#e8e8ea). Fix (verified in /app/frontend/src/components/canvas/ExcalidrawCanvasView.js) removes the viewBackgroundColor override and passes theme='dark' so the default light canvas is inverted into a proper dark obsidian bg.
